rita, justitia, cuculli, satisfactiones, gratia & misericordia exaltaban-

marginalia.note: Præceptum adorandi solius Dei Creatoris adorationi & cultui religioso creaturarum in Papatu recepto opponitur.

page.notes: Greek word after "pagana" is not legible at this scan resolution; left as illegible. "μεσιτεία" is a best reading of the Greek word for mediation, uncertain. "Religiosa" in the italic phrase is uncertain (the letters near "Religio-" are blurred). "vestitu" in the verse is uncertain. The catchword "bis," sits at the lower right, and the text ends on the hyphenated "mor-" as printed.
